name: Kingsley's Barbers
greeting: Hello, you're through to Kingsley's Barbers. I'm the AI assistant on this demo line. How can I help?
summary: Kingsley's Barbers is a barber shop in Nottingham: Fades, classic cuts, beards and hot towel shaves.
core_facts: Kingsley's Barbers: Fades, classic cuts, beards and hot towel shaves, at 22 Hockley Row (example), Nottingham NG1.
Sunday: 10am till 3pm. Tuesday and Wednesday and Friday: 9am till 6pm. Thursday: 9am till 8pm. Saturday: 8am till 5pm. Closed Mondays.
Barbers: Marcus (the owner: skin fades, Afro and textured hair, designs); Dan (classic cuts, beards and hot towel shaves); Jordan (cuts and kids); Amira (cuts, grey blending and beard colour).
Appointments by phone, and walk-ins welcome when a chair is free: a booking comes first.
A £5 deposit is taken when booking if they can, and comes off the price; if not, they pay in the shop. Free to cancel or move with 24 hours' notice; later than that, the deposit is kept.
Paid in the shop, cash or card, or by card when booking.

knowledge.q: How much is a cut? What are your prices?
knowledge.a: Classic cut £18 (30 minutes); Skin fade £22 (45 minutes); Cut and beard £28 (50 minutes); Beard trim £12 (20 minutes); Hot towel shave £20 (30 minutes); Kids' cut £13 (30 minutes); Grey blending from £25 (45 minutes); Beard colour £15 (30 minutes).
Classic cut: Scissors and clippers, finished with a neck shave. About 30 minutes, £18.
Skin fade: Faded down to the skin at the back and sides, blended into the length on top. About 45 minutes, £22.

knowledge.q: What is a cut and beard?
knowledge.a: Cut and beard: Any cut, with the beard shaped and lined up. About 50 minutes, £28.
Beard trim: Shaped, lined up and finished with oil. About 20 minutes, £12.

knowledge.q: What is a hot towel shave?
knowledge.a: Hot towel shave: A traditional straight-razor shave with hot towels. About 30 minutes, £20.
Kids' cut: For under-12s. About 30 minutes, £13.
Grey blending: Softens the grey without a flat colour; needs a skin test first. About 45 minutes, from £25.
Beard colour: Colour for the beard; needs a skin test first. About 30 minutes, £15.

knowledge.q: Which days does each barber work?
knowledge.a: Marcus: Sunday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Dan: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Jordan: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday (Thursday 9am to 6pm). Amira: Friday and Saturday.
Marcus: The owner: skin fades, Afro and textured hair, designs. Dan: Classic cuts, beards and hot towel shaves. Jordan: Cuts and kids. Amira: Cuts, grey blending and beard colour.
Walk-ins are welcome when a chair is free, but bookings come first, so it's worth booking a time.
Yes: the kids' price is for under-12s. Under-16s come with an adult.
Yes: the same services at the same prices as anyone, a short back and sides or a fade included.

knowledge.q: Do you do Afro and textured hair?
knowledge.a: Yes: Marcus specialises in Afro and textured hair.

knowledge.q: Is there a charge for paying by card?
knowledge.a: No: there's no extra charge for paying by card.

knowledge.q: What if I need to cancel or move my booking?
knowledge.a: A £5 deposit is taken when booking if they can, and comes off the price; if not, they pay in the shop. Free to cancel or move with 24 hours' notice; later than that, the deposit is kept.
Up to 10 minutes late is fine; later than that we may need to move you to the next free time.

knowledge.q: What if I'm not happy with my cut?
knowledge.a: Let us know within 7 days and we'll put it right for free, with the same barber or another.

knowledge.q: Do I need a skin test for colour?
knowledge.a: Yes: a quick skin test at least 48 hours before every colour, as the dye's instructions say. If you've ever reacted to hair dye, we won't colour your hair: speak to your GP or pharmacist.
Step-free from the street, with room for a wheelchair at every chair. Ask for a quiet time and we will book one.
There's no parking at the shop: the Lace Market and Victoria Centre car parks are a few minutes' walk.
We sell the wax, clay, oils and beard balm we use in the shop.
Tips are welcome, and the barbers keep all of them.
We're always happy to hear from barbers and apprentices: drop your details in, or leave a message.
We don't do home visits.
